svg.aria-label: Cascade rig: five server cells share one load beam. The lit health-check drum at the beam's left end is the component that failed — servers stopped passing its checks and dropped off the beam, and the survivors took the whole load. One cell lies flat on the plate, one is mid-fall, three still stand. The health dial's needle has dropped into the orange zone and the load dial's needle has spiked into it. Numbers from the 12 Nov 2026 Microsoft 365 outage: 19,650 reports per minute at peak, 74 countries, more than five hours down.
